recipes.name: Sauerbraten
recipes.description: German pot roast marinated for days in vinegar-wine spices, served with sweet-sour gravy.

ingredients.name: Red Wine Vinegar & Red Wine Marinade

steps.instruction: Marinate beef refrigerated 3-5 days, turning daily.
Pat dry, brown; strain marinade over with vegetables.
Braise covered ~3 hours until tender.
Strain liquid; thicken with gingersnaps/roux into sweet-sour gravy.

videos.videoTitle: Sauerbraten Rhenish - Authentic German Sauerbraten Recipe
videos.channelName: German Recipes by All Tastes German

recipes.name: Rouladen
recipes.description: Beef rolls stuffed with mustard, bacon-free pickles and onions, braised in red-wine gravy.

steps.instruction: Spread mustard; lay pickle + onion; roll tight and tie.
Brown rolls on all sides; add stock and wine.
Braise covered 90 minutes; reduce sauce.

videos.videoTitle: Beef Rouladen - Delicious Beef Rolls from Germany

recipes.name: Deutscher Rindergulasch
recipes.description: Paprika-rich beef goulash stewed till spoonable - German pub staple with Spätzle.

steps.instruction: Brown beef well; remove; cook onions deep gold.
Off heat stir paprikas + paste; back with meat and stock.
Simmer covered ~2 hours until saucy-tender.

videos.videoTitle: German Beef Goulash (Rindergulasch) with My Spicy Twist | Served with Spätzle

recipes.name: Frikadellen
recipes.description: Pan-fried seasoned beef patties - German comfort across every generation.

steps.instruction: Knead everything gently; form thick oval patties.
Fry in butter medium-high 5-6 min per side.

videos.videoTitle: Frikadellen – Authentic German Meatballs | Juicy & Easy to Make!

recipes.name: Rinds-Gulasch
recipes.description: Rich Hungarian-influenced beef stew with paprika, caraway, and a velvety onion gravy.

steps.instruction: Sauté onions in lard until golden, stir in paprika and caraway.
Brown beef in batches, return to pot with garlic and tomato paste.
Add broth, cover, and simmer gently for 2 hours until fork-tender.
Adjust seasoning and serve with bread dumplings or spaetzle.

recipes.name: Schmorbraten
recipes.description: Slow-braised beef pot roast in a dark beer and root-vegetable gravy.

steps.instruction: Season and sear beef on all sides until deeply browned.
Remove, sauté vegetables and tomato paste in the same pot.
Deglaze with beer, return beef, add bay leaf and juniper.
Cover and braise at 160 °C for 2½ hours; slice and serve with gravy.

videos.videoTitle: German Cuisine: Schmorbraten mit saurer Sahnensauce (Pot Roast & gravy)

recipes.name: Rinderrouladen
recipes.description: Thin beef rolls stuffed with mustard, onions, and pickles, braised in red-wine gravy.

steps.instruction: Pound beef slices thin, spread mustard, layer bacon, onion, and pickle.
Roll tightly and secure with kitchen twine.
Dredge in flour, sear until browned on all sides.
Add wine and broth, braise covered for 90 minutes until tender.

videos.videoTitle: How to make Traditional German Beef Rouladen｜Rinderrouladen｜ Rouladen｜best German Rouladen Recipe

recipes.name: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes
recipes.description: Tender veal strips in a creamy mushroom and white-wine sauce.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in butter until translucent, add veal strips and brown.
Deglaze with white wine, add mushrooms, and cook until softened.
Stir in cream, simmer until sauce thickens slightly.
Finish with parsley and serve over buttered egg noodles.

recipes.name: Kalbshaxe
recipes.description: Crispy-skin roasted veal shank braised with root vegetables and dark beer.

steps.instruction: Score the skin of the veal shank in a crosshatch pattern.
Season generously and sear skin-side down until golden.
Add vegetables, garlic, bay leaves, and beer to the roasting pan.
Roast at 180 °C for 2½ hours, basting occasionally; serve with potatoes.

recipes.name: Schweinshaxe
recipes.description: Bavarian crispy-skin pork knuckle slow-roasted with caraway and served with sauerkraut.

steps.instruction: Score pork skin, rub with salt, caraway, and garlic.
Place in roasting pan with onion, bay leaf, and beer.
Roast at 160 °C for 2 hours, then blast at 220 °C for 20 minutes for crisp skin.
Serve with sauerkraut and boiled potatoes.

recipes.name: Schweinebraten
recipes.description: Classic German pork roast with a crispy rind, dark beer gravy, and root vegetables.

steps.instruction: Score rind in a diamond pattern, rub with salt and caraway.
Sear rind-side down until golden, then flip and add vegetables.
Pour in beer, add bay leaves, and roast at 180 °C for 2 hours.
Rest 15 minutes, thicken pan juices with flour for gravy, and serve with potatoes.

recipes.name: Bratwurst
recipes.description: Grilled German pork sausage with a crisp snap, served with tangy mustard and potato salad.

steps.instruction: Simmer bratwursts gently in broth until just cooked through.
Grill or pan-fry over medium-high heat until casings are golden and crisp.
Prepare potato salad with warm broth, onion, and vinegar dressing.
Serve sausages in a pretzel roll with mustard and potato salad.

recipes.name: Leberkäse
recipes.description: Sliced Bavarian meatloaf with a golden crust, served warm on a roll with sweet mustard.

steps.instruction: Blend ground meats with onion, egg, and breadcrumbs until very smooth.
Press into a loaf tin, smooth top, and roast at 200 °C for 50 minutes.
Brush with oil and broil until the top develops a golden-brown crust.
Slice thickly, serve warm on a roll with sweet mustard and pickles.

recipes.name: Fleischkäse
recipes.description: Savory German meatloaf glazed with ketchup, sliced and served with potato salad.

steps.instruction: Soak bread roll in milk, squeeze dry, and combine with ground meats.
Mix in eggs, onion, and mustard; season generously.
Shape into a loaf, brush with ketchup glaze.
Bake at 180 °C for 55 minutes; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Wetzlarer Rindfleisch
recipes.description: Marinated German beef roast slow-cooked with juniper, bay, and dark beer.

steps.instruction: Rub beef with mustard, juniper, pepper, and bay.
Sear on all sides in a hot Dutch oven until deeply browned.
Add onion, carrots, and beer; cover and braise at 160 °C for 2½ hours.
Slice against the grain and spoon pan juices over the top.

recipes.name: Schichtsalat
recipes.description: Layered German salad with potatoes, eggs, ham, pickles, and a creamy dressing.

steps.instruction: Arrange sliced potatoes in even layers in a deep dish.
Layer ham, pickles, peas, and sliced eggs over the potatoes.
Mix mayonnaise and sour cream, spread evenly over the top.
Chill for at least 2 hours; garnish with spring onion before serving.

recipes.name: Hackbraten
recipes.description: Classic German meatloaf with a tangy ketchup glaze, served with creamy potato salad.

steps.instruction: Soak bread roll in milk, squeeze dry, and mix with ground beef, eggs, onion, and mustard.
Shape into a loaf, place in a roasting pan, and brush with ketchup.
Bake at 180 °C for 50 minutes until cooked through.
Rest 10 minutes, slice, and serve with warm potato salad.

recipes.name: Rinderstroganoff
recipes.description: Tender beef strips in a creamy paprika and sour-cream sauce over egg noodles.

steps.instruction: Sear beef strips quickly in batches over high heat; set aside.
Sauté onion and mushrooms in butter until softened.
Stir in paprika, add broth, and simmer 5 minutes.
Return beef, stir in sour cream, and serve over buttered egg noodles.

recipes.name: Schweinerippchen
recipes.description: Smoky glazed pork ribs slow-cooked until fall-off-the-bone tender.

steps.instruction: Rub ribs with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and brown sugar.
Wrap in foil and slow-cook at 150 °C for 3 hours.
Unwrap, brush generously with BBQ glaze and vinegar.
Grill or broil for 10 minutes until caramelized; serve with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Zwiebelrostbraten
recipes.description: German roast beef topped with deeply caramelized onions in a rich brown gravy.

steps.instruction: Season and dredge beef roast in flour, sear on all sides in hot butter.
Remove beef, slowly caramelize onion rings in the same pan with caraway.
Deglaze with beer and broth, return beef, cover and braise at 160 °C for 1½ hours.
Slice beef, spoon caramelized onions and gravy over the top, garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Hähnchenschnitzel
recipes.description: Chicken schnitzel pounded thin, breaded, fried to a rippling golden crust.

steps.instruction: Season; breading line flour-egg-crumb, pressing crumbs on.
Fry generous oil ~3 min per side until golden, swirling pan.
Drain on rack; lemon over immediately.

recipes.name: Hühnerfrikassee
recipes.description: Gentle white-fricassee of chicken, asparagus or peas in lemony cream sauce over rice.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken gently; keep broth; tear into pieces.
Make velouté with butter-flour + poaching broth; season lemony.
Fold chicken and vegetables through; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Paprikahähnchen
recipes.description: Hungarian-inherited braised chicken in lush red paprika sauce - GDR-era canteen hero.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; soften onions/peppers.
Off-heat bloom paprika; add passata + splash stock.
Cover and simmer 40 min; swirl sour cream in off boil.

recipes.name: Knuspriges Brathähnchen
recipes.description: The Wiesn-style crackling roast chicken - salted crisp skin, juicy breast.

steps.instruction: Dry-brine flattened chicken 1 hour uncovered fridge.
Roast at 200°C skin-up 60-70 minutes until deeply crisp.
Rest 10 minutes; cut halves.

recipes.name: Haehnchenbrustfilet
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken breast seasoned with garlic and fresh herbs.

steps.instruction: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness, season with salt, pepper, garlic, and thyme.
Heat oil in a skillet, sear chicken 5 minutes per side until golden.
Add butter and lemon juice, baste chicken for 1 minute.
Rest 3 minutes, slice, and garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Haehnchenschenkel
recipes.description: Roasted chicken thighs with crispy skin, garlic, and fresh rosemary.

steps.instruction: Toss chicken thighs with oil, salt, pepper, garlic, and lemon zest.
Arrange on a tray with potato cubes and rosemary.
Roast at 200 °C for 35 minutes until skin is crispy and golden.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Kraeuterhaehnchen
recipes.description: Herb-crusted roasted chicken with thyme, sage, and buttery pan juices.

steps.instruction: Mix softened butter with thyme, sage, garlic, and lemon zest.
Rub herb butter under and over the chicken skin.
Place carrots and onion in roasting pan, set chicken on top.
Roast at 180 °C for 1 hour 15 minutes, basting every 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Backhendl
recipes.description: Traditional Austrian-style crispy buttermilk-fried chicken pieces.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken pieces in buttermilk for at least 2 hours.
Mix flour with paprika and garlic powder; beat the egg separately.
Dredge chicken in flour, dip in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry at 170 °C for 12 minutes until golden and cooked through; serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Haendl
recipes.description: Simple German roast chicken with caraway, salt, and crispy golden skin.

steps.instruction: Rub chicken inside and out with butter, salt, pepper, and caraway.
Place onion halves inside the cavity.
Roast at 190 °C for 1 hour 10 minutes, basting with pan drippings.
Let rest 10 minutes, carve, and serve with roasted potatoes and parsley.

recipes.name: Pfeffersteak vom Haehnchen
recipes.description: Cracked-pepper chicken cutlet pan-fried golden with herb butter.

steps.instruction: Pound chicken breasts to 5 mm thickness, season with salt and pepper.
Dust with flour, dip in beaten egg, then press cracked pepper onto both sides.
Pan-fry in butter over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley; serve immediately.

recipes.name: Gegrilltes Haehnchen
recipes.description: Lemon-and-herb grilled chicken thighs with a smoky char.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken thighs in lemon juice, oil, garlic, oregano, and paprika for 1 hour.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill chicken 5 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Rest 3 minutes, slice, and serve with grilled bell peppers and parsley.

recipes.name: Haehnchencurry
recipes.description: German-style chicken curry with coconut milk, sweet pepper, and curry paste.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic, stir in curry paste until fragrant.
Add chicken and brown on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk, add bell pepper, and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over jasmine rice, garnished with spring onion.

recipes.name: Haehnchennudelsuppe
recipes.description: Hearty German chicken noodle soup with egg noodles, carrots, and root vegetables.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion, carrots, celery, and parsnip until softened.
Add broth and chicken breast, bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred, and return to pot with egg noodles.
Cook noodles until tender, stir in shredded chicken and dill.

recipes.name: Schmorhahn
recipes.description: Dark-beer braised chicken with root vegetables and juniper berries.

steps.instruction: Season chicken quarters with salt, pepper, and mustard.
Sear skin-side down in a Dutch oven until deeply browned.
Add vegetables, beer, juniper, and bay; cover tightly.
Braise at 170 °C for 1 hour until falling off the bone.

recipes.name: Haehnchen mit Kartoffeln
recipes.description: One-pan roasted chicken thighs with baby potatoes, rosemary, and lemon.

steps.instruction: Toss potatoes with oil, salt, and rosemary; spread on a baking tray.
Nestle chicken thighs among potatoes, season with salt and pepper.
Add lemon slices and garlic cloves to the tray.
Roast at 200 °C for 40 minutes until chicken is golden and potatoes are crisp.

recipes.name: Blumenkohl-Haehnchen
recipes.description: Creamy cauliflower and chicken gratin with melted cheese and nutmeg.

steps.instruction: Blanch cauliflower florets for 3 minutes; drain well.
Season and sear diced chicken in butter until just cooked.
Combine chicken and cauliflower in a gratin dish, pour cream over.
Top with cheese and breadcrumbs, bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Huehnerfrikassee
recipes.description: Creamy German chicken fricassee with pearl onions, carrots, and white-wine sauce.

steps.instruction: Sear diced chicken in butter until golden; set aside.
Sauté pearl onions and carrots, stir in flour to make a roux.
Deglaze with white wine, add cream, and simmer until thickened.
Return chicken, cook 5 minutes, and serve over buttered egg noodles.

recipes.name: Rahmhaehnchen
recipes.description: German creamy paprika chicken with peppers and a rich sour-cream finish.

steps.instruction: Sear chicken thighs until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion and peppers, stir in paprika and tomato paste.
Add broth, return chicken, cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in sour cream, serve over egg noodles.

recipes.name: Hahnchenbrust Senf
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken breast with mustard cream

steps.instruction: Season and sear chicken breast.
Sauté onion and garlic.
Add mustard and cream.
Simmer chicken in sauce until done.

recipes.name: Käsespätzle
recipes.description: Swabian egg noodles layered with mountain cheese and fried onions - Germany's mac & cheese.

steps.instruction: Beat sticky batter; rest 15 minutes.
Scrape through spätzle maker into salted boiling water; scoop when floating.
Layer noodles-cheese-onions in a dish; quick bake/melt.
Top with crispy onions and chives.

recipes.name: Kartoffelpuffer
recipes.description: Crisp-edged potato pancakes with applesauce - market-square winter food.

steps.instruction: Mix potatoes, onion, eggs, flour, seasoning fast before weeping.
Fry thin rounds in hot fat until lacy-crisp both sides.
Serve hot with cold applesauce.

videos.videoTitle: German Potato Pancakes | Kartoffelpuffer | Reibekuchen Homemade

recipes.name: Vegetarian Linseneintopf
recipes.description: Hearty lentil stew with root vegetables and smoked paprika - no sausage needed.

steps.instruction: Sweat onions; bloom paprika briefly.
Add lentils, roots, stock; simmer 40 minutes.
Balance with vinegar; mash some lentils to thicken.

recipes.name: Schupfnudeln mit Kraut
recipes.description: Potato dumpling fingers rolled by hand, fried crisp with buttery braised cabbage.

steps.instruction: Knead potato dough; roll ropes; cut and taper into fingers.
Brief-poach, then fry in butter until golden crusts form.
Meanwhile braise cabbage with caraway; toss together.

recipes.name: Kartoffelsuppe
recipes.description: Creamy Bavarian potato soup with leeks, carrots, and crispy croutons.

steps.instruction: Sauté leek and carrots in butter until softened.
Add potatoes and broth, bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture, return to pot, and stir in cream.
Toast bread cubes in butter for croutons; serve soup topped with croutons and chives.

recipes.name: Spaetzle
recipes.description: Hand-scraped Swabian egg noodles tossed in brown butter with crispy onions.

steps.instruction: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, salt, and nutmeg into a thick, sticky batter.
Press batter through a spaetzle maker or colander into boiling salted water.
Cook until noodles float, then drain and rinse briefly.
Brown butter with sliced onions until crisp, toss spaetzle in the brown butter, and serve.

recipes.name: Kaesespaetzle
recipes.description: Baked Swabian spaetzle layered with melted gruyere and topped with crispy onions.

steps.instruction: Brown sliced onions in butter until deeply caramelized; set aside.
Make a light roux with butter and flour, whisk in milk, season with nutmeg.
Layer spaetzle and cheese in a baking dish, pour sauce between layers.
Top with remaining cheese and crispy onions, bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.name: Rotkohl
recipes.description: Sweet-and-sour braised red cabbage with apples, cloves, and red-wine vinegar.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in butter until softened, add shredded cabbage and apple.
Stir in vinegar, sugar, cloves, and bay leaf.
Cover and braise over low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season to taste and serve warm as a side.

recipes.name: Sauerkraut
recipes.description: Traditional German fermented cabbage slowly simmered with juniper and caraway.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in butter until translucent.
Add sauerkraut, grated apple, caraway, juniper, and bay leaf.
Pour in wine, cover, and simmer gently for 30 minutes.
Season with a pinch of sugar if needed; serve warm.

videos.videoTitle: Deftiges Sauerkraut zubereiten und kochen nach Oma's Rezept

recipes.name: Linseneintopf
recipes.description: Hearty German red lentil stew with smoked paprika, carrots, and crusty bread.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic until softened, stir in paprika and tomato paste.
Add lentils, carrots, and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season well, ladle into bowls, and top with fresh parsley.

recipes.name: Erbseneintopf
recipes.description: Thick German split-pea soup with vegetables, potatoes, and fresh marjoram.

steps.instruction: Rinse split peas and soak for 30 minutes if time allows.
Sauté onion, carrot, and celery until softened.
Add peas, potatoes, broth, bay leaf, and marjoram; bring to a boil.
Simmer covered for 40 minutes until thick and creamy; season to taste.

recipes.name: Kohlrabigratin
recipes.description: Creamy kohlrabi gratin with nutmeg, gruyere, and crispy breadcrumb topping.

steps.instruction: Boil kohlrabi slices in salted water for 8 minutes until just tender; drain.
Heat cream with garlic and nutmeg; pour over kohlrabi in a gratin dish.
Top with grated cheese and buttered breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Wirsingauflauf
recipes.description: Braised Savoy cabbage rolls filled with rice, herbs, and a creamy cheese sauce.

steps.instruction: Blanch cabbage leaves for 2 minutes; pat dry and trim thick ribs.
Sauté onion in butter, mix with cooked rice and dill.
Place filling on each leaf, roll tightly, and arrange seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour cream over rolls, top with cheese, bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Apfelsalat
recipes.description: Crisp German apple-and-walnut salad with a tangy honey-vinaigrette dressing.

steps.instruction: Slice apples thinly and toss with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Whisk honey, vinegar, and oil into a vinaigrette.
Combine apples, celery, walnuts, and raisins in a bowl.
Dress just before serving over a bed of crisp lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Gemueseauflauf
recipes.description: Baked vegetable gratin with zucchini, tomatoes, peppers, and melted mozzarella.

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 200 °C and lightly oil a baking dish.
Layer vegetables in alternating rows with garlic and olive oil.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 30 minutes until vegetables are tender and cheese is golden; garnish with basil.

recipes.name: Kohlrouladen
recipes.description: Cabbage leaves stuffed with rice, herbs, and mushrooms in a creamy tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Blanch cabbage leaves for 2 minutes, pat dry, trim thick ribs.
Sauté onion and mushrooms, mix with cooked rice and dill.
Place filling on each leaf, roll tightly, and arrange seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour tomato sauce and cream over rolls, top with parmesan, bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Maultaschen
recipes.description: Swabian filled pasta pockets stuffed with spinach, bread, and onion.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion, mix with spinach, bread, eggs, and nutmeg for the filling.
Roll pasta dough thin, place filling mounds, fold, and seal edges.
Cook maultaschen in simmering broth for 10 minutes until they float.
Remove, slice into strips, and pan-fry in butter until lightly golden.

recipes.name: Zwiebelkuchen
recipes.description: Savoury German onion tart with smoky bacon, cream, and caraway on a yeasted base.

steps.instruction: Roll out dough and line a greased tart pan; pre-bake blind for 10 minutes.
Sauté onions and bacon until onions are soft and translucent.
Whisk sour cream, eggs, caraway, thyme, and nutmeg together.
Spread onion mixture over base, pour custard on top, bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Kassler
recipes.description: Smoked and cured pork chop served with sauerkraut and mustard sauce.

steps.instruction: Rinse sauerkraut and simmer with onion, apple, bay, and caraway for 20 minutes.
Pan-fry smoked pork chop until heated through and lightly seared.
Prepare mustard cream sauce from pan drippings.
Plate with sauerkraut, pork chop, mustard sauce, and boiled potatoes.

recipes.name: Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte
recipes.description: Black Forest gateau: chocolate sponge, kirsch cherries, whipped cream, chocolate curls.

steps.instruction: Bake chocolate sponges; cool; split as needed.
Drain cherries; soak layers with kirsch syrup.
Fill with cream and cherries between layers; coat sides in cream.
Press chocolate curls around; crown with cream rosettes + cherries.

recipes.name: Apfelstrudel
recipes.description: Paper-thin stretched dough around rum-raisin apples, baked until shatteringly crisp.

steps.instruction: Stretch dough over a cloth to transparency; butter it.
Toast breadcrumbs in butter; mix with apples, sugar, raisins, cinnamon.
Roll tightly using the cloth; seam down.
Bake 190°C 35-40 min; dust with powdered sugar; serve warm.

videos.videoTitle: The Secret Behind How Original Viennese Apple Strudel Is Made | Food Secrets Ep. 10

recipes.name: Birnen Spekulatius
recipes.description: Poached pears in spiced red-wine syrup served with crushed speculoos biscuits.

steps.instruction: Combine red wine, sugar, cinnamon, cloves, and lemon peel in a saucepan.
Add pears and poach gently for 25 minutes until tender but intact.
Reduce poaching liquid to a thick syrup over medium heat.
Serve pears warm with reduced syrup, crushed speculoos, and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

recipes.name: Kaiserschmarrn
recipes.description: Fluffy torn Austrian pancake dusted with powdered sugar and served with plum compote.

steps.instruction: Whisk eggs with sugar and vanilla until fluffy, fold in flour and milk.
Melt butter in a large pan, pour in batter, and cook over medium-low heat.
When set, tear into rough pieces with two forks and brown lightly.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately with warm plum compote.

recipes.name: Streuselkuchen
recipes.description: Classic German crumb cake with a buttery streusel topping on a soft yeast base.

steps.instruction: Prepare yeast dough and let rise until doubled.
Rub cold butter, flour, sugar, and cinnamon into coarse streusel crumbs.
Roll out dough, press into a greased sheet pan, and let rest 15 minutes.
Spread streusel evenly over top, sprinkle with pearl sugar, bake at 190 °C for 22 minutes.

recipes.name: Berliner
recipes.description: Traditional German jelly doughnut dusted with powdered sugar and filled with raspberry jam.

steps.instruction: Prepare yeast dough with lemon zest, let rise until doubled.
Divide into 12 pieces, shape into smooth balls, let rest 20 minutes.
Deep-fry at 170 °C for 3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Drain, fill with jam using a piping bag, and dust generously with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Schokoladenpralinen
recipes.description: Handmade German chocolate pralines with a smooth ganache center and cocoa dusting.

steps.instruction: Heat cream and pour over chopped chocolate, stir until smooth.
Add butter, rum, vanilla, and espresso; stir until glossy.
Chill ganache for 2 hours, then roll into small balls.
Roll in cocoa powder or dip in tempered chocolate; let set at room temperature.

recipes.name: Dresdner Stollen
recipes.description: Iconic German Christmas bread packed with dried fruit, marzipan, and powdered sugar.

steps.instruction: Knead dried fruits and almonds into the stollen dough; let rise 1 hour.
Roll dough into an oval, place marzipan log off-centre, fold dough over.
Let rest 30 minutes, then bake at 175 °C for 50 minutes.
Brush generously with melted butter and dust heavily with powdered sugar while warm.

recipes.name: Bienenstich
recipes.description: Layered German bee-sting cake with a caramelized almond topping and vanilla cream filling.

steps.instruction: Prepare yeast dough, divide into two layers, let rise.
Make almond caramel with honey, butter, sugar, and almonds; spread over top layer.
Bake both layers at 190 °C for 18 minutes until almond topping is golden.
Fill bottom layer with whipped vanilla custard cream, place almond layer on top.

recipes.name: Butterkuchen
recipes.description: Traditional German sheet cake with dimples of melted butter and crunchy pearl sugar.

steps.instruction: Prepare yeast dough with lemon zest, let rise until doubled.
Roll out dough into a greased sheet pan, let rest 15 minutes.
Press deep dimples all over with fingertips, fill each with a dot of butter.
Sprinkle with sugar, vanilla sugar, pearl sugar, and almonds; bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes.

recipes.name: Hahnchen Paprika
recipes.description: Chicken breast in creamy paprika sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken and sear.
Sauté onion and garlic.
Add paprika and cream.
Simmer chicken in sauce.

recipes.name: Linseneintopf Spezial
recipes.description: Hearty German lentil stew with vegetables

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add lentils, carrots, and potatoes with water.
Cook until lentils are soft.
Season with vinegar, salt, and pepper.
